about: Approved serving state per Vault ask service (WS3 C1.4). desired_mode is what is APPROVED to serve now; objective is the business goal, judged separately (a keyword-only match never certifies usable meaning search). Changing desired_mode is a reviewed edit by Robert or the release lead (for example to 'meaning' when promotion is approved). canary stays null until Robert chooses the record and question; refs only, never text.
